name: Question 3
worked_solution:
If $F=P\,i+Q\,j+R\,k$ is a vector field on ${R}^{3}$ and the partial derivatives of the components of $F$ all exist, then the curl of $F$ is the vector field given by

$$
curl\,F=∇\times F=|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ \frac{∂}{∂x} & \frac{∂}{∂y} & \frac{∂}{∂z} \\ P & Q & R\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{curl}\,F & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ \frac{∂}{∂x} & \frac{∂}{∂y} & \frac{∂}{∂z} \\ x{e}^{yz} & yz & {e}^{yz}\end{aligned}| \\  & =[\frac{∂}{∂y}({e}^{yz})-\frac{∂}{∂z}(yz)]i-[\frac{∂}{∂x}({e}^{yz})-\frac{∂}{∂z}(x{e}^{yz})]j+[\frac{∂}{∂x}(yz)-\frac{∂}{∂y}(x{e}^{yz})]k \\  & =(z{e}^{yz}-y)\,i-(0-xy{e}^{yz})\,j+(0-xz{e}^{yz})\,k \\  & =(z{e}^{yz}-y)\,i+xy{e}^{yz}\,j-xz{e}^{yz}\,k.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 3

Given that F(x,y,z)=xeyzi+yzj+eyzk, what is curlF?

a
zeyzi+xyeyzj−xzeyzk
b
(zeyz−y)i+(xyeyz−z)j−x2eyzk
c
(zeyz−y)i+xyeyzj−xzeyzk
d
−yi+xyeyzj+xzeyzk
e
(xeyz−z)i+xeyzj−xzeyzk
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

If F=Pi+Qj+Rk is a vector field on R3 and the partial derivatives of the components of F all exist, then the curl of F is the vector field given by

curlF=∇×F=|ijk∂∂x∂∂y∂∂zPQR|.

Therefore, we have

curlF=|ijk∂∂x∂∂y∂∂zxeyzyzeyz|=[∂∂y(eyz)−∂∂z(yz)]i−[∂∂x(eyz)−∂∂z(xeyz)]j+[∂∂x(yz)−∂∂y(xeyz)]k=(zeyz−y)i−(0−xyeyz)j+(0−xzeyz)k=(zeyz−y)i+xyeyzj−xzeyzk.
